dedupe_keys.name: eu space surveillance and tracking eu sst services collision avoidance re entry and fragmentation analysis

description: EU SST provides three space surveillance and tracking services. Collision Avoidance assesses the risk of collision between spacecraft, or between spacecraft and space debris, and generates collision avoidance alerts. Re-entry Analysis assesses the risk of uncontrolled re-entry of man-made space objects into the Earth's atmosphere within 30 days. Fragmentation Analysis detects and characterises in-orbit fragmentations, break-ups or collisions. The services are provided on request to EU Member States, EU institutions, spacecraft owners and operators and other public and private entities. Access is free of charge but requires registration in the SST Service Provision Portal. The services page states that more than 400 organisations receive the services and more than 700 satellites are covered. Caveat: outputs are alerts and reports delivered to registered users about objects in orbit worldwide (global coverage), not an open dataset, and the portal itself is rendered by script. For infrastructure studies it documents the operational hazard of debris and re-entry to satellites that support navigation, communications and Earth observation; related records are the ESA DISCOS database and the Space-Track satellite catalogue.
